headline: On last trading day, Sensex gained over 300 points, though markets logged a seventh straight weekly decline.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 28 September.

why: Geopolitical developments, crude oil prices, and US bond yields are expected to steer upcoming market direction.
Indian benchmark indices ended a seventh consecutive week lower despite late-week recovery gains.
Auto and consumer durables sectors gained nearly 1% during the previous session.
Private sector capex is projected to rise to ₹3.2 trillion in FY27, according to an RBI bulletin.
whatHappening: Indian equity markets are closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, September 28.
The Supreme Court is set to hear a plea challenging the imposition of MDR on UPI on September 28.
Companies like ITC are expanding dairy business operations, while Axis Bank announced major campus hiring plans.
Investors are closely watching global cues, GIFT Nifty signals, and crude oil price movements for opening triggers.
summary:
Markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, September 28.
In the last session, Sensex rose over 300 points as auto and consumer durables posted gains.
Key factors to watch next week include crude oil prices, geopolitical updates, and US yields.
